candidate_semantics: Bounded DuckDB/httpfs queries may return nearby Overture building IDs and bbox values only. No exact HMLR parcel, address, UPRN or gas-emissions row is claimed without independent identity proof.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Three canonical sample rows and missing exact building identity.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Three canonical Enfield Point carriers are parcel_30762 / HMLR INSPIRE 46058185 at -0.0407406,51.6769078; parcel_30763 / 46037757 at -0.052972,51.6767314; and parcel_30764 / 45981756 at -0.0482579,51.6776898. They do not contain exact building polygons, Overture GERS IDs or UPRNs.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Current confirmed release and proposed-release boundary.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: At access time the official Overture release calendar identifies 2026-06-17.0 as the current release and lists 2026-07-22.0 as a proposed future release subject to change. Wave353 therefore queries the confirmed 2026-06-17.0 release.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official S3 source-of-record path and cloud-native query contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture publishes core map data as GeoParquet on Amazon S3 at s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/<RELEASE>. The official S3 and Azure distributions are the source of record, and DuckDB can query cloud files while transferring only requested data.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official building query, release path and bbox-pruning pattern.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The official DuckDB guide requires DuckDB 1.1.0 or newer plus httpfs for Amazon S3. It queries buildings from s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-06-17.0/theme=buildings/type=building/* with hive_partitioning=1 and bbox filters.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: DuckDB httpfs installation and S3 Parquet read contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: DuckDB documents that reading Parquet from S3 requires the httpfs extension, loaded with INSTALL httpfs and LOAD httpfs, followed by read_parquet on an s3:// path. Public file reads use HTTP range requests.

The buildings theme exposes id, geometry and a bbox struct whose xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax fields use longitude and latitude. Bbox filtering can produce nearby building candidates but does not prove HMLR parcel identity or UPRN.
